## TabStation 2.18.3

- After an in-app update, "Open" in the installer now takes you straight back to the desktop (with the "Starting…" screen) when TabStation was on, and a message confirms the new version. Before, Settings opened first and the desktop jumped back a few seconds later.
- From 2.18.0: new setup guide, new Settings with a sidebar, in-app updates, splash screen, "Report a bug", Windows 11 style menus and many fixes. See the 2.18.0 notes for the full list.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. From 2.18.0 on, TabStation updates itself from Settings → Version & updates.

## TabStation 2.18.2

- Fixed: after an update the Dock stayed off and Android's 3-button navigation bar came back until Home was pressed. Opening TabStation (for example "Open" in the installer after updating) now brings the Dock back right away.
- From 2.18.0: new setup guide, new Settings with a sidebar, in-app updates, splash screen, "Report a bug", Windows 11 style menus and many fixes. See the 2.18.0 notes for the full list.

Requires Android 10+. Shizuku is recommended. Install over the previous version; settings are kept. From 2.18.0 on, TabStation updates itself from Settings → Version & updates.
